rules.statement: Parole evidence is permitted to prove a constructive trust between parties, even if the document is contrary to Section 2 of the Prevention of Frauds Ordinance, if the attendant circumstances support the trust.
rules.supporting_quote: In order to establish legal principles discussed in Section 83 of the Trust Ordinance, in my view, it is necessary to lead parole evidence between the parties. If this evidence is shut out, the purpose of Section 83 of the Trust Ordinance would be rendered nugatory.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 2 of the Prevention of Frauds Ordinance
